purpose: Highlight a distinctive strength that only a particular source offers.
keywords: express wishes wants obligation permission request advice
N + ならではの + N; N + ならではだ
It has a warmth unique to handmade things.
This view is something only the summit can offer.
The ingenuity unique to a craftsperson shines through.
formation: N + ならではの + N; N + ならではだ
restrictions: Typically praises a characteristic tied to a place, person, or craft.
mistake: Use の to modify a noun; do not insert だ before ならでは.
